LESSON: PEACE

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: Citizenship and Governance in Kenya
Topic 5.2: Peace
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Peace, part of Citizenship and Governance in Kenya in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: How can we live in peace with others in school? 2) Why is it important to plan for a peace building activity in school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Peace together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking: Learners create messages on strategies of living in peace with others in school.

● Problem solving: Learners participate in peace building activities in school.

Values:
● Patriotism: Learners design posters on peace building messages.

● Peace: Learners show respect as they participate in peace building activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Citizenship: Learners promote peace education as they use digital, braille or print resources to create messages on peace and display

them at strategic points in the school compound.

● Coping with emotion: Learners create a safe school as they participate in peace building activities.

Links to other Learning Areas:
● Religious Education as learners discuss in groups ways of promoting peace in school.

● English, Kiswahili and KSL as learners discuss in groups ways of promoting peace in school.

Suggested Learning Resources

• Vetted devices with assistive technology,

• Braille resources,

• Posters
